controls.title: Security Management Process - Standard
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

controls.title: Risk Analysis
controls.desc: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI held by the covered entity or business associate.

controls.title: Risk Management
controls.desc: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with the Security Rule.

controls.title: Sanction Policy
controls.desc: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.

controls.title: Information System Activity Review
controls.desc: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.desc: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by the Security Rule.

controls.title: Workforce Security - Standard
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of the workforce have appropriate access to ePHI and to prevent unauthorized access.

controls.title: Authorization and/or Supervision
controls.desc: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with ePHI or in locations where it might be accessed.

controls.title: Workforce Clearance Procedure
controls.desc: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to ePHI is appropriate.

controls.title: Termination Procedures
controls.desc: Implement procedures for terminating access to ePHI when the employment of, or other arrangement with, a workforce member ends.

controls.title: Information Access Management - Standard
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI that are consistent with the applicable requirements of the Privacy Rule.

controls.title: Isolating Health Care Clearinghouse Functions
controls.desc: If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, the clearinghouse must implement policies and procedures that protect ePHI from unauthorized access by the larger organization.

controls.title: Access Authorization
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to ePHI, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.

controls.title: Access Establishment and Modification
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the entity's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training - Standard
controls.desc: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of the workforce, including management.

controls.title: Security Reminders
controls.desc: Periodic security updates provided to all workforce members.

controls.title: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.desc: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.

controls.title: Log-in Monitoring
controls.desc: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.

controls.title: Password Management
controls.desc: Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures - Standard
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

controls.title: Response and Reporting
controls.desc: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the entity; and document security incidents and their outcomes.

controls.title: Contingency Plan - Standard
controls.desc: Establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems that contain ePHI.

controls.title: Data Backup Plan
controls.desc: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.

controls.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.desc: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to restore any loss of data.

controls.title: Emergency Mode Operation Plan
controls.desc: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of ePHI while operating in emergency mode.

controls.title: Testing and Revision Procedures
controls.desc: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.

controls.title: Applications and Data Criticality Analysis
controls.desc: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.desc: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this rule and subsequently in response to environmental or operational changes.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts and Other Arrangements
controls.desc: A covered entity may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI on its behalf only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurances through a written contract or arrangement.

controls.title: Written Contract or Other Arrangement
controls.desc: Document the satisfactory assurances required through a written contract or other arrangement with the business associate.

controls.title: Access Control - Standard
controls.desc: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

controls.title: Unique User Identification
controls.desc: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.

controls.title: Emergency Access Procedure
controls.desc: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary ePHI during an emergency.

controls.title: Automatic Logoff
controls.desc: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.

controls.title: Encryption and Decryption
controls.desc: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.desc: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

controls.title: Integrity - Standard
controls.desc: Implement policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Mechanism to Authenticate Electronic Protected Health Information
controls.desc: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.desc: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.

controls.title: Transmission Security - Standard
controls.desc: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

controls.title: Integrity Controls
controls.desc: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.desc: Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate during transmission.

controls.title: Policies for Information Security
controls.desc: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals or if significant chan

controls.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
controls.desc: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated. All information security responsibilities shall be clearly defined and allocated to ensure proper implementation and operation of the ISMS.

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.desc: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.

controls.title: Management Responsibilities
controls.desc: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.title: Contact with Authorities
controls.desc: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and supervisory authorities.

controls.title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
controls.desc: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.desc: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence for the organization.

controls.title: Information Security in Project Management
controls.desc: Information security shall be integrated into project management regardless of the type of the project.

controls.title: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.desc: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

controls.title: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
controls.desc: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented.

controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.desc: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organization's assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract, or agreement.

controls.title: Classification of Information
controls.desc: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability, and relevant interested party requirements.

controls.title: Labelling of Information
controls.desc: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.title: Information Transfer
controls.desc: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.desc: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.title: Identity Management
controls.desc: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed, including registration, provisioning, administration, and deprovisioning of user identities.

controls.title: Authentication Information
controls.desc: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

controls.title: Access Rights
controls.desc: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.

controls.title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships
controls.desc: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.

controls.title: Addressing Information Security Within Supplier Agreements
controls.desc: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.

controls.title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
controls.desc: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented for managing information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, Review, and Change Management of Supplier Services
controls.desc: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

controls.title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
controls.desc: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.desc: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing, and communicating information security incident management processes, roles, and responsibilities.

controls.title: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
controls.desc: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.

controls.title: Response to Information Security Incidents
controls.desc: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
controls.desc: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

controls.title: Collection of Evidence
controls.desc: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

controls.title: Information Security During Disruption
controls.desc: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
controls.desc: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

controls.title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory, and Contractual Requirements
controls.desc: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date.

controls.title: Intellectual Property Rights
controls.desc: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.title: Protection of Records
controls.desc: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with legislative, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

controls.title: Privacy and Protection of Personal Identifiable Information (PII)
controls.desc: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII as required in applicable legislation, regulations, and contractual requirements.

controls.title: Independent Review of Information Security
controls.desc: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes, and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

controls.title: Compliance with Policies, Rules, and Standards for Information Security
controls.desc: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented Operating Procedures
controls.desc: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.

controls.title: User Endpoint Devices
controls.desc: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.title: Privileged Access Rights
controls.desc: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.desc: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Access to Source Code
controls.desc: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

controls.title: Secure Authentication
controls.desc: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.desc: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

controls.title: Protection Against Malware
controls.desc: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.desc: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated, and appropriate measures shall be taken.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.desc: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services, and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored, and reviewed.

controls.title: Information Deletion
controls.desc: Information stored in information systems, devices, or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data Masking
controls.desc: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

controls.title: Data Leakage Prevention
controls.desc: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and any other devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information.

controls.title: Information Backup
controls.desc: Backup copies of information, software, and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

controls.title: Redundancy of Information Processing Facilities
controls.desc: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.desc: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected, and analyzed.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.desc: Networks, systems, and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.title: Clock Synchronization
controls.desc: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

controls.title: Use of Privileged Utility Programs
controls.desc: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.desc: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

controls.title: Networks Security
controls.desc: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.title: Security of Network Services
controls.desc: Security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented, and monitored.

controls.title: Segregation of Networks
controls.desc: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks.

controls.title: Web Filtering
controls.desc: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.desc: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.desc: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

controls.title: Application Security Requirements
controls.desc: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure System Architecture and Engineering Principles
controls.desc: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system development activities.

controls.title: Secure Coding
controls.desc: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.title: Security Testing in Development and Acceptance
controls.desc: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development lifecycle.

controls.title: Outsourced Development
controls.desc: The organization shall direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.title: Separation of Development, Test, and Production Environments
controls.desc: Development, testing, and production environments shall be separated and secured to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the production environment.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.desc: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

controls.title: Test Information
controls.desc: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected, and managed.

controls.title: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
controls.desc: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

controls.title: Project Management Framework
controls.desc: Establish project management framework for consistency in practices.

controls.title: IT Project Plans
controls.desc: Detailed IT project plans for all IT projects.

controls.title: Project Documentation Management
controls.desc: Maintain and approve key documentation in IT project lifecycle.

controls.title: COTS Security Assessment
controls.desc: Risk assessment for COTS solutions not meeting security requirements.

controls.title: Source Code Escrow
controls.desc: Source code escrow agreement for critical acquired software.

controls.title: SDLC Framework
controls.desc: Establish framework to manage system development life cycle.

controls.title: Security-by-Design
controls.desc: Security-by-design approach building security in every SDLC phase.

controls.title: SDLC Security Requirements
controls.desc: Security requirements covering access control, authentication, data integrity, logging.

controls.title: Security Function in SDLC
controls.desc: Involve IT security function in each SDLC phase.

controls.title: System Requirements Analysis
controls.desc: Identify and document functional requirements including performance and security.

controls.title: Security Threat Assessment
controls.desc: Assess potential threats and risks to determine acceptable security level.

controls.title: Architecture Design Review
controls.desc: Review proposed architecture and design including IT controls.

controls.title: Implementation Verification
controls.desc: Verify system requirements are met by design and implementation.

controls.title: Expert Design Review
controls.desc: Engage domain experts including security specialists in design review.

controls.title: System Testing Methodology
controls.desc: Testing methodology covering business logic, function, security, performance.

controls.title: Requirements Traceability
controls.desc: Trace requirements during testing, ensure coverage by test cases.

controls.title: Test Environment Separation
controls.desc: Maintain separate testing environments, restrict access.

controls.title: Regression Testing
controls.desc: Regression testing for changes to existing IT systems.

controls.title: Test Issue Management
controls.desc: Track and address issues from testing, report major issues.

controls.title: Test Documentation
controls.desc: Document test results in test report, signed off by stakeholders.

controls.title: Quality Attributes Definition
controls.desc: Define quality attributes and assessment metrics during project planning.

controls.title: Independent Quality Assurance
controls.desc: Independent QA function for project activities and deliverables.

controls.title: Secure Coding Standards
controls.desc: Adopt standards on secure coding, source code review and application security testing.

controls.title: Secure Coding Practices
controls.desc: Standards covering secure programming, input validation, output encoding, access controls.

controls.title: Third Party Code Management
controls.desc: Policy on use of third party and open-source software codes.

controls.title: Dependency Vulnerability Tracking
controls.desc: Track updates and reported vulnerabilities for third party codes.

controls.title: Application Security Testing Strategy
controls.desc: Comprehensive application security testing strategy (SAST, DAST, IAST).

controls.title: Security Defect Remediation
controls.desc: Track issues from code review and security testing, remediate before deployment.

controls.title: Agile Security Integration
controls.desc: Incorporate SDLC and security-by-design in Agile development.

controls.title: Agile Secure Coding
controls.desc: Apply secure coding standards during Agile development.

controls.title: DevSecOps Alignment
controls.desc: Align DevSecOps with SDLC framework and IT service management.

controls.title: DevSecOps Security Controls
controls.desc: Security measures and segregation of duties in DevSecOps.

controls.title: API Security Safeguards
controls.desc: Establish safeguards for API development and provisioning.

controls.title: Third Party API Vetting
controls.desc: Vetting process for third parties connecting via APIs.

controls.title: API Security Standards
controls.desc: Security standards for API design including key/token protection.

controls.title: API Data Encryption
controls.desc: Strong encryption for sensitive data through APIs.

controls.title: API Security Testing
controls.desc: Security screening and testing of APIs, log access sessions.

controls.title: API Monitoring
controls.desc: Real-time monitoring for API usage and suspicious activities.

controls.title: API Capacity and DoS Protection
controls.desc: System capacity for high API volumes, mitigate DoS attacks.

controls.title: Shadow IT Management
controls.desc: Control shadow IT and end user computing as part of information assets.

controls.title: Shadow IT Controls
controls.desc: Measures to control and monitor shadow IT use.

controls.title: Patch Management Process
controls.desc: Patch management process with timeframes based on criticality.

controls.title: Patch Testing
controls.desc: Test patches before applying to production.

controls.title: Cryptographic Applications
controls.desc: Cryptography for data confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity.

controls.title: Cryptographic Standards Adoption
controls.desc: Adopt algorithms from international standards with appropriate key length.

controls.title: Random Number Security
controls.desc: Sufficient length and randomness for cryptographic seeds.

controls.title: Algorithm Testing
controls.desc: Cryptographic algorithms subject to rigorous testing.

controls.title: Cryptographic Monitoring
controls.desc: Monitor cryptanalysis developments, update algorithms as needed.

controls.title: Key Management Policy
controls.desc: Key management covering generation, distribution, renewal, revocation, recovery, expiry.

controls.title: Key Generation Security
controls.desc: Keys securely generated and protected from unauthorised disclosure.

controls.title: Key Lifespan Management
controls.desc: Determine appropriate key lifespan based on data sensitivity and risk.

controls.title: Hardware Key Storage
controls.desc: Manage keys in hardened/tamper resistant systems (HSM).

controls.title: Key Distribution Security
controls.desc: Keys not exposed during transmission, use out-of-band channel.

controls.title: Key Diversification
controls.desc: Use keys for single purpose.

controls.title: Compromised Key Response
controls.desc: Revoke and replace compromised keys.

controls.title: Key Destruction
controls.desc: Secure key destruction for expired/revoked keys.

controls.title: Key Renewal Independence
controls.desc: New key generation independent of previous compromised key.

controls.title: Key Backup
controls.desc: Maintain backups of cryptographic keys for recovery.

controls.title: System Hardening Standards
controls.desc: Security standards for hardware and software configurations.

controls.title: Configuration Compliance
controls.desc: Verify standards applied uniformly, address deviations.

controls.title: Endpoint Protection
controls.desc: Endpoint protection including behavioural and signature-based solutions.

controls.title: Anti-Malware Management
controls.desc: Keep anti-malware signatures up-to-date, regular scanning.

controls.title: Threat Detection and Response
controls.desc: Detection and response for IOCs, monitor for anomalies.

controls.title: Application Whitelisting
controls.desc: Application white-listing for authorised software only.

controls.title: BYOD Security
controls.desc: Comprehensive risk assessment and security measures for BYOD.

controls.title: Virtualisation Security Standards
controls.desc: Security standards for all virtualisation components.

controls.title: Virtual Image Management
controls.desc: Policies for managing virtual images and snapshots.

controls.title: IoT Risk Controls
controls.desc: Assess and implement controls for IoT risks.

controls.title: IoT Monitoring
controls.desc: Monitor IoT devices for suspicious activities.

controls.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence
controls.desc: Collect, process, and analyse cyber-related information.

controls.title: Threat Information Sharing
controls.desc: Procure cyber intelligence monitoring, participate in information sharing.

controls.title: Misinformation Response
controls.desc: Detect and respond to misinformation related to the FI.

controls.title: Security Operations Centre
controls.desc: SOC or managed security services for continuous monitoring.

controls.title: System Log Management
controls.desc: Collect, process, review, retain system logs.

controls.title: Baseline Activity Profiles
controls.desc: Establish baseline profiles of system activities for anomaly detection.

controls.title: User Behavioural Analytics
controls.desc: Apply user behavioural analytics for security monitoring.

controls.title: Event Correlation
controls.desc: Correlate multiple events to identify suspicious patterns.

controls.title: Security Escalation
controls.desc: Timely escalation of suspicious activities or behaviour.

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment Process
controls.desc: Regular vulnerability assessment of IT systems.

controls.title: VA Scope
controls.desc: VA scope covering vulnerability discovery, weak configs, open ports, web vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.desc: PT for in-depth evaluation with blackbox and greybox testing.

controls.title: Bug Bounty Programme
controls.desc: Bug bounty to complement penetration testing.

controls.title: Production Environment PT
controls.desc: PT on production environment with safeguards.

controls.title: PT Frequency
controls.desc: PT frequency based on system criticality and exposure.

controls.title: Cyber Exercises
controls.desc: Regular scenario-based cyber exercises.

controls.title: Exercise Stakeholder Involvement
controls.desc: Involve relevant stakeholders in cyber exercises.

controls.title: Adversarial Attack Simulation
controls.desc: Red team exercise to validate cyber defence.

controls.title: Exercise Rules of Engagement
controls.desc: Define objectives, scope, rules of engagement.

controls.title: Intelligence-Based Scenarios
controls.desc: Design realistic threat scenarios based on plausible cyber threats.

controls.title: Threat Actor Analysis
controls.desc: Design scenarios using threat intelligence relevant to IT environment.

controls.title: Remediation Management
controls.desc: Comprehensive remediation process with severity assessment and timeframes.

controls.title: Online Financial Services Security
controls.desc: Security measures commensurate with risk for online services.

controls.title: Communication Channel Security
controls.desc: Secure channels with encryption and digital signatures.

controls.title: Web Application Security
controls.desc: Minimise exposure to common attack vectors.

controls.title: Mobile Application Risk Management
controls.desc: Address risks unique to mobile applications.

controls.title: Secure App Distribution
controls.desc: Apps only through official stores or secure channels.

controls.title: Anti-Phishing Monitoring
controls.desc: Monitor for phishing campaigns, take immediate action.

controls.title: Rooted/Jailbroken Device Controls
controls.desc: Disallow rooted/jailbroken devices unless application sandboxed.

controls.title: Password Transmission Security
controls.desc: End-to-end encryption for customer password transmission.

controls.title: Transaction Signing
controls.desc: Digital signatures for high-risk activities.

controls.title: Biometric Data Protection
controls.desc: Encrypt biometric data and authentication credentials.

controls.title: Biometric Performance Calibration
controls.desc: Biometric solution performance calibrated to risk.

controls.title: Credential Storage Security
controls.desc: Store authentication credentials in tamper-resistant form.

controls.title: Real-Time Fraud Monitoring
controls.desc: Real-time fraud monitoring to detect and block suspicious transactions.

controls.title: Suspicious Transaction Investigation
controls.desc: Process to investigate suspicious transactions.

controls.title: Customer Suspicious Activity Notification
controls.desc: Notify customers of suspicious activities above threshold.

controls.title: Customer Security Education
controls.desc: Inform customers of security best practices for online services.

controls.title: Cyber Threat Customer Alerts
controls.desc: Alert customers of new cyber threats timely.

controls.title: Unauthorised Transaction Detection Guidance
controls.desc: Advise customers on detecting unauthorised transactions.

controls.desc: Entities shall ensure security in the acquisition, development, and maintenance of network and information systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

controls.title: Vulnerability Handling and Disclosure
controls.desc: Entities shall establish procedures for identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities in their network and information systems, including coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

controls.title: Network Security Architecture
controls.desc: Entities shall implement appropriate network security measures including segmentation, firewalls, intrusion prevention, and secure network architecture design.

controls.title: Secure Configuration Management
controls.desc: Entities shall implement secure configuration management for all network and information systems, including hardening standards, change management, and configuration monitoring.

controls.title: Patch and Update Management
controls.desc: Entities shall implement formal patch management processes ensuring timely application of security patches and updates to all network and information systems.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.desc: Entities shall implement formal change management processes to ensure that all changes to network and information systems are assessed for security impact before implementation.

controls.title: Physical Device Inventory
controls.desc: Physical devices and systems within the organization are inventoried.

controls.title: Software Platform Inventory
controls.desc: Software platforms and applications within the organization are inventoried.

controls.title: Data Flow Mapping
controls.desc: Organizational communication and data flows are mapped.

controls.title: Resource Prioritization
controls.desc: Resources are prioritized based on their classification, criticality, and business value.

controls.title: Supply Chain Role
controls.desc: The organization's role in the supply chain is identified and communicated.

controls.title: Critical Infrastructure Role
controls.desc: The organization's place in critical infrastructure and its industry sector is identified.

controls.title: Organizational Cybersecurity Policy
controls.desc: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established and communicated.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Roles Coordination
controls.desc: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are coordinated and aligned with internal roles and external partners.

controls.title: Asset Vulnerabilities Identified
controls.desc: Asset vulnerabilities are identified and documented.

controls.title: Threat Intelligence
controls.desc: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.

controls.title: Threats Identified
controls.desc: Threats, both internal and external, are identified and documented.

controls.title: Risk Prioritization
controls.desc: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to determine risk.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.desc: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified and documented.

controls.title: Identity and Credential Management
controls.desc: Identities and credentials are issued, managed, verified, revoked, and audited.

controls.title: Physical Access Management
controls.desc: Physical access to assets is managed and protected.

controls.title: Remote Access Management
controls.desc: Remote access is managed.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.desc: Access permissions and authorizations are managed incorporating least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.title: Network Integrity Protection
controls.desc: Network integrity is protected incorporating network segregation where appropriate.

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.desc: All users are informed and trained.

controls.title: Privileged Users Training
controls.desc: Privileged users understand their roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Data-at-Rest Protection

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular

controls.title: Source code review for coding/security vulnerabilities

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Security requirements in system requirements specifications
controls.desc: Security requirements (functional, technical and assurance) developed and implemented as part of system requirements specifications.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Application review for external connections

controls.title: Assessment of office utility software macros/scripts

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Policy/procedure to review/test user-developed macros and scripts
controls.desc: Formulate policy/procedure to review and test user-developed macros and scripts before use to ensure integrity and reliability of applications.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Media classification per contained information

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Visual identifiable classification labelling
controls.desc: Classification of all media must be visually identifiable; labelling scheme documented and uniformly applied across the organization; media protected against tampering.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Media sanitization process with tested tools
controls.desc: Define process and procedures for media sanitization; identify and adopt tools; testing conducted at regular intervals to ensure effectiveness of the tool.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Authorized personnel for media repair/maintenance
controls.desc: Only authorized personnel carry out repairs and maintenance work on classified media.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Documented destruction and disposal procedures
controls.desc: Document procedures for the destruction and disposal of media.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Degaussing and physical destruction (smashing, drilling)
controls.desc: Destroy media by degaussing non-volatile media and physically destroying media through smashing and drilling.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Supervised destruction with due diligence
controls.desc: Staff members supervise destruction of media; due diligence carried out during destruction.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Discreet media/waste disposal preventing dumpster diving
controls.desc: Disposal of media/media waste shall not attract undue attention possibly leading to dumpster diving attempts by malicious users.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Physical security of DC perimeter, building, facility and equipment room

controls.title: Physical security against unauthorised access to systems/MFDs/racks/tapes

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Board and senior management governance of outsourced processes

controls.title: Formal contract of service

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Approval requirement for significant subcontracting
controls.desc: Outsourcing arrangement must include approval requirement for significant subcontracting of services and provisions by original technology service provider.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Right-to-audit by internal/external auditors and QCB examiners
controls.desc: Outsourcing agreements include provisions outlining right to audit service providers by internal or external auditor and QCB examiners.

controls.title: Regular security and incident reporting by third party

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Provider-site measures for normal operation in exceptional events

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Hosting physically located within Qatar

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular
controls.title: Change management and monitoring of 3P; service quality maintained
controls.desc: Third party vendors and technology outsourcing companies subject to bank's change management and monitoring controls; quality and availability of banking services to end users and customers not negatively affected due to outsourcing.

controls.fw: Qatar Central Bank Technology Risks Circular

controls.desc: The head of information security/CISO shall be independent of the technology function to avoid any conflict of interest.

controls.title: IS framework to include risk monitoring and reporting

controls.title: IS framework to include threat intelligence and industry collaboration
controls.desc: The IS framework must include threat intelligence and industry collaboration mechanisms.

controls.title: Apply technical controls commensurate with FI situation
controls.desc: The level of sophistication of technical controls employed by individual FIs is contingent on that FI's individual situation.

controls.title: Implement automated solutions to monitor cyber attacks
controls.desc: Implement automated solutions to monitor and proactively track all types of cyber attacks.

controls.title: Incorporate consistent approach for selecting security controls
controls.desc: Incorporate a consistent and comparable approach for selecting and specifying security controls for computer systems.

controls.title: Develop and implement internal assessment methods for security controls
controls.desc: Develop and implement internal assessment methods/procedures for determining security control effectiveness.

controls.title: Deploy multi-layer security model
controls.desc: Deploy multi-layer security model including firewalls, secure sign-on, dual authentication with triangulation of access and real-time security event monitoring.

controls.title: Share cyber threat intelligence with relevant staff
controls.desc: FIs shall ensure that cyber threat intelligence is shared with relevant staff responsible for cyber risk mitigation at strategic, tactical and operational levels through a secure method.

controls.desc: FIs shall use a platform within the industry for collecting and exchanging timely information to facilitate detection, response, resumption and recovery following a cyber attack, breach or incident.

controls.desc: FIs shall monitor technological developments and keep abreast with new cyber risk management processes that can effectively counter existing and new forms of cyber threats.

controls.desc: System control standards shall include an application's functional, security, and automated control features.

controls.title: Conduct security and vulnerability assessments of software modules
controls.desc: Security and vulnerability assessment of software modules shall be conducted.

controls.title: Prohibit development personnel from accessing production systems
controls.desc: FIs shall ensure that system development personnel are prohibited from having access to production systems.

controls.title: Control access to documentation libraries
controls.desc: FIs shall control access to documentation libraries with appropriate library and version controls.

controls.title: Ensure complete and secure system documentation
controls.desc: FIs shall ensure that complete and updated system documentation of applications is available and secured against unauthorized access.

controls.title: Security Objective: Security and Integrity of Data and Systems
controls.desc: The Internet Banking Security Framework shall ensure security and integrity of data and systems, ensuring that customers' information has not been modified and systems are free from unauthorized access.

controls.title: Security Controls Implementation
controls.desc: The bank shall ensure appropriate security arrangements and security controls to protect IT assets are in place, developed based on the Security Risk Assessment and commensurate with risk levels. The bank shall define minimum baseline Secur

controls.title: Security Controls for In-house Functions
controls.desc: Security controls applicable to bank employees who are users of Internet Banking related systems, covering access rights management, OS controls, remote access, physical access, network security, firewalls, IDS/IPS, identity theft preventio

controls.title: Operating Systems Controls
controls.desc: Necessary Operating Systems' controls should be implemented to ensure access is physically and logically secured, with privileged access restricted, regularly monitored and periodically audited.

controls.title: IT Network Security
controls.desc: IT networks shall be secured through the use of multiple layers of controls.

controls.title: Firewalls
controls.desc: Firewalls shall be deployed between different security domains to control network traffic. Firewall selection and deployment policy should be devised according to the characteristics of the network including traffic volume and risk classifi

controls.title: IDS/IPS Deployment
controls.desc: Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) should be deployed between different security domains as per their risk classification.

controls.title: Security Controls Monitoring
controls.desc: Bank shall develop and implement a formally approved mechanism for monitoring of Security Controls, including an analysis of the effectiveness of existing or proposed monitoring methods.

controls.title: Network Activity Monitoring
controls.desc: The monitoring mechanism shall cover monitoring of bank's network activity by collecting and analyzing host and network data related to security events, such as privileged access to sensitive operating systems, configuration changes, and ac

controls.title: Policy Violation and Unauthorized Configuration Change Identification
controls.desc: The monitoring mechanism shall include identification and listing of bank's policy violations, unauthorized configuration changes and other conditions which can potentially increase the risk of security breaches.

controls.title: Log and Audit Trail Monitoring and Retention
controls.desc: Procedures shall ensure monitoring of logs and audit trails on a regular and predefined periodic basis. Internet Banking security logs and audit trails shall be retained for a period of ten years.

controls.title: COSO Principle 1: Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
controls.desc: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values. The board of directors and management, at all levels, demonstrate through directives, actions, and behavior the importance of integrity and ethical values to support the

controls.title: COSO Principle 2: Board Independence and Oversight
controls.desc: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 3: Management Establishes Structure, Authority, and Responsibility
controls.desc: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 4: Commitment to Competence
controls.desc: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 5: Accountability for Internal Control
controls.desc: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 13: Quality Information for Internal Control
controls.desc: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 14: Internal Communication
controls.desc: The entity internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 15: External Communication
controls.desc: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 6: Specifies Suitable Objectives
controls.desc: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 7: Identifies and Analyzes Risk
controls.desc: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.

controls.title: COSO Principle 8: Considers Potential for Fraud
controls.desc: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 9: Identifies and Assesses Significant Change
controls.desc: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 16: Selects and Develops Ongoing and Separate Evaluations
controls.desc: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.

controls.title: COSO Principle 17: Evaluates and Communicates Deficiencies
controls.desc: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action, including senior management and the board of directors, as appropriate.

controls.title: COSO Principle 10: Selects and Develops Control Activities
controls.desc: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.

controls.title: COSO Principle 11: Selects and Develops General Controls over Technology
controls.desc: The entity also selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 12: Deploys Through Policies and Procedures
controls.desc: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and in procedures that put policies into action.

controls.title: Logical and Physical Access Security Software, Infrastructure, and Architectures
controls.desc: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: User Access Provisioning and De-provisioning
controls.desc: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity.

controls.title: Role-Based Access and Least Privilege
controls.desc: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected information assets based on roles, responsibilities, or the system design and changes, giving consideration to the concepts of least privil

controls.title: Physical Access Restrictions
controls.desc: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets (for example, data center facilities, back-up media storage, and other sensitive locations) to authorized personnel to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Logical and Physical Access Disposal and Destruction
controls.desc: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data and software from those assets has been diminished and is no longer required to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Security Measures Against Threats Outside System Boundaries
controls.desc: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.

controls.title: Restricts Data Transmission, Movement, and Removal
controls.desc: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes, and protects it during transmission, movement, or removal to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Prevention and Detection of Unauthorized Software
controls.desc: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Detection and Monitoring of Security Events
controls.desc: To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify (1) changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities, and (2) susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Monitoring System Components for Anomalies
controls.desc: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives.

controls.title: Security Event Evaluation
controls.desc: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the entity to meet its objectives (security incidents) and, if so, takes actions to prevent or address such failures.

controls.title: Security Incident Response
controls.desc: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program to understand, contain, remediate, and communicate security incidents, as appropriate.

controls.title: Recovery from Security Incidents
controls.desc: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

controls.title: Change Management Controls
controls.desc: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.

controls.title: Risk Mitigation Identification and Assessment
controls.desc: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.

controls.title: Vendor and Business Partner Risk Management
controls.desc: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Encryption Key Management
controls.desc: The entity manages encryption keys used to protect confidential information and personal data throughout their lifecycle.

controls.title: Security Event Logging
controls.desc: The entity implements logging and monitoring of security-relevant events to support the detection of security incidents and support forensic investigation activities.

controls.title: Business Continuity Planning
controls.desc: The entity develops, maintains, and tests business continuity plans to ensure continuity of operations during and after significant disruptions.
